written.headline: New York governor signs law banning unsafe AI chatbot features for minors
written.summary: Governor Kathy Hochul signed two bills that prohibit AI chatbots from using unsafe features with users under 18 and require security safeguards on internet‑connected baby monitors. The chatbot law mandates age verification, bans certain behaviors, and imposes up to $25,000 civil penalties per violation; it takes effect in six months.

written.headline: Anthropic expands AI for Science program to 20 foundations and research groups
written.summary: Anthropic announced that its AI for Science program now includes 20 scientific foundations, institutions and research groups worldwide, providing them with free Claude credits for high‑impact projects. The expansion builds on earlier efforts that already supported hundreds of biology, medicine, physics, chemistry, climate and mathematics projects.
